Game Overview

In Choco Benno 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a whimsical 2D platforming adventure in Choco Benno 2. Navigate through eight delightful yet challenging levels, dodging chocolate-loving monsters and navigating treacherous obstacles. Master strategic double jumps to secure glasses of delicious milkshake and safely reach the fabled Chocolate exit door. Dare to conquer this charming, chocolaty sequel!
